answer_1.quote: We focus on competition-level code generation, following the setup established by . For a given LLM, the input consists of a problem statement P and a set of public test cases T pub , each defined by an input-output pair. The goal is to develop an inference framework that enables the code generation model M to produce the correct code C ∼ M (P, T pub ) solving the given problem.

answer_2.quote: We use pass rate and pass@1 as the evaluation metrics for code correctness following . Pass rate is the average percentage of private test cases successfully passed by the generated code across all problems, and pass@1 measures the percentage of problems where the generated programs pass all private test cases .

answer_3.quote: Once all public test cases are passed, we further instruct the LLM to provide a self-assessed comprehensive score, v llm , to evaluate the code's correctness in solving the whole problem.
